import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; const Home = () => { const [currentTestimonial, setCurrentTestimonial] = useState(0); const testimonials = [ { quote: "Nile Orphan Care didn't just give me shelter - they gave me a family, an education, and most importantly, they believed in me when I couldn't believe in myself. Today, I'm a registered nurse helping others, just like they helped me.", name: "Sarah M.", title: "Registered Nurse, Class of 2019" }, { quote: "When I arrived at NOC, I was 8 years old and had lost everything. The staff became my family, and education became my hope. Now I'm an engineer, building bridges - literally and figuratively - for my community.", name: "Michael K.", title: "Civil Engineer, Class of 2017" }, { quote: "The life skills program at NOC taught me more than just academics. I learned leadership, responsibility, and how to dream big. Today, I run my own business and employ 12 people from my community.", name: "Grace A.", title: "Entrepreneur, Class of 2018" } ]; useEffect(() => { const timer = setInterval(() => { setCurrentTestimonial((prev) => (prev + 1) % testimonials.length); }, 5000); return () => clearInterval(timer); }, [testimonials.length]); const nextTestimonial = () => { setCurrentTestimonial((prev) => (prev + 1) % testimonials.length); }; const prevTestimonial = () => { setCurrentTestimonial((prev) => (prev - 1 + testimonials.length) % testimonials.length); }; return (
{/* Hero Section */}

Transforming Lives Along the Nile

Providing hope, education, and care for orphaned children in need. Together, we can build a brighter future for every child through comprehensive support, quality education, and unwavering commitment to their wellbeing.

{/* Welcome Section */}

Welcome to Nile Orphan Care

Transforming lives through compassionate care and unwavering commitment

For over a decade, we have been a beacon of hope for orphaned and vulnerable children across the Nile region. Our comprehensive approach ensures every child receives the love, care, and opportunities they deserve.

From emergency shelter to long-term development, we walk alongside each child on their journey to independence, providing not just basic needs but the foundation for a bright future.

01

Safe Haven

Secure homes with loving caregivers who provide stability and emotional support

02

Education First

Quality learning opportunities that unlock potential and build bright futures

03

Building Futures

Life skills and vocational training that prepare children for independence

04

Healthcare Support

Comprehensive medical care ensuring physical and mental wellbeing for all children

05

Community Integration

Building strong connections with local communities for sustainable support networks

06

Empowerment Programs

Leadership development and mentorship to help children become confident advocates

1,200+ Children Served
8 Care Centers
150+ Success Stories
15+ Years of Service
{/* How You Can Help Section */}

How You Can Make a Difference

Your support creates lasting change in the lives of vulnerable children. Choose the way that works best for you to join our mission of hope and transformation.

Monthly Sponsorship

Starting at $35/month

Become a child's champion through monthly sponsorship. Your consistent support covers education, healthcare, nutritious meals, and emotional care. You'll receive updates, photos, and letters from your sponsored child, creating a meaningful bond that lasts a lifetime.

  • Direct impact on one child's life
  • Regular updates and communication
  • Tax-deductible contributions
  • Optional visit opportunities

One-Time Donation

Any amount helps

Make an immediate impact with a one-time gift. Your donation provides emergency care, educational materials, medical treatment, facility improvements, or supports our general operations. Every dollar goes directly toward changing lives.

  • Immediate impact on urgent needs
  • 100% goes to programs
  • Flexible giving options
  • Memorial and honor gifts available

Volunteer Opportunities

Share your talents

Join our dedicated team of volunteers and make a hands-on difference. Whether you're a teacher, healthcare professional, tradesperson, or simply someone with a caring heart, we have meaningful ways for you to contribute your time and skills.

  • Teaching and tutoring programs
  • Healthcare and counseling support
  • Administrative and fundraising help
  • Skills-based volunteering opportunities

Corporate Partnerships

Scale your impact

Partner with us to create meaningful corporate social responsibility programs. From employee engagement initiatives to major capital projects, we'll work with your organization to develop impactful partnerships that align with your values and goals.

  • Employee volunteer programs
  • Matching gift opportunities
  • Facility naming rights
  • Custom partnership packages

Fundraising Events

Rally your community

Organize fundraising events in your community, workplace, or social circles. From charity runs to bake sales, birthday fundraisers to corporate challenges, every event helps raise awareness and vital funds for our children.

  • Event planning support and materials
  • Online fundraising tools
  • Recognition and appreciation
  • Community building opportunities

Spread Awareness

Amplify our mission

Help us reach more people by sharing our story. Follow us on social media, share our posts, tell friends and family about our work, or invite us to speak at your organization. Your voice can help us find more supporters and advocates.

  • Social media advocacy
  • Speaking engagement opportunities
  • Ambassador program participation
  • Community outreach support
{/* Success Stories Section */}

Stories of Hope

From Vulnerability to Victory

Every child who walks through our doors brings a unique story. Some arrive scared and alone, others come with dreams bigger than their circumstances. What unites them all is the transformation that happens when love, care, and opportunity meet.

Our graduates have become teachers, nurses, engineers, and community leaders. They return not just as success stories, but as mentors and advocates, proving that with the right support, every child can overcome their past and build an extraordinary future.

"Nile Orphan Care didn't just give me shelter - they gave me a family, an education, and most importantly, they believed in me when I couldn't believe in myself. Today, I'm a registered nurse helping others, just like they helped me."
- Sarah M., Class of 2019
